topic: MCP vs Skills: Connectivity over Knowledge
text:
Skills are internal logic. MCP is the nervous system.

I've learned that teaching agents is a bottleneck; connecting them is the scale.

No se trata de lo que el modelo sabe, sino de lo que puede alcanzar.

The bridge matters more than the library.

¿Estás construyendo cerebros o puentes?

#AIEngineering #MCP #LLMs
